name: ai.yonyon/docs
title: yonyon.ai Docs
description: Read-only yonyon.ai documentation: search, list and read pages as Markdown. No sign-in.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Use this when you need to find which yonyon.ai documentation page answers a question. Returns the matching doc ids, titles and paths, so you can follow up with read_docs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to match against doc titles and summaries.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Use this when you want to see everything the docs cover before choosing a page. Returns every page this server can read, with id, title and path: developers, auth, pricing, sandbox, llms, MCP, api-versioning, homepage, agent-instructions.

limit.description: Optional cap on how many doc entries to return (default: all pages).

tools.name: read_docs
tools.description: Use this when you know which page you need. Returns that yonyon.ai documentation page as markdown. Pass the id from list_docs or search_docs (developers, auth, pricing, sandbox, llms, mcp, api-versioning, home, agent-instructions).

id.description: Doc id from list_docs or search_docs.
